title: Translation Actions on Non-Unimodular Groups and Strong Ergodicity
summary: We investigate translation actions of countable dense subgroups of non-unimodular locally compact second countable (lcsc) groups. Using left-right actions, we show that the left translation action $Γ\curvearrowright G$ given by a countable dense subgroup $Γ$ of a locally compact second countable group $G$ can only be strongly ergodic if $G$ is almost unimodular.
